extraction_text: Yuyutsu (月授) was struck by Satyaki's (萨谛奇) arrow and fell unconscious, causing his charioteer to hastily withdraw him from battle.
Ashwatthama (马嘶), enraged by Yuyutsu's injury, charged toward the Satvatas (沙特婆多人).
Ghatotkacha (瓶首), enraged by Ashwatthama's charge, intercepted him with his terrifying chariot and Rakshasa army.
Ghatotkacha's Rakshasa army unleashed a fierce nocturnal assault with weapons and illusions, causing panic among the Kaurava forces.
Ashwatthama alone remained fearless, dispelling Ghatotkacha's illusions with his arrows.
Ghatotkacha, angered by the dispelling of his illusions, shot terrible arrows that struck Ashwatthama.
Ashwatthama, enraged, retaliated by shooting ten arrows that struck Ghatotkacha.
Ghatotkacha, severely wounded, hurled a divine flying discus at Ashwatthama to kill him.

supernatural_elements: Flying discus with radiant, jeweled edges

extraction_text: Ashwatthama deflected the flying discus with his arrows, causing it to fall to the ground.
Ghatotkacha, seeing his discus deflected, covered Ashwatthama with a shower of arrows.
Anjalika (黑眼膏), son of Ghatotkacha, intervened to block Ashwatthama's advance.
Ashwatthama, tormented by Anjalika's arrows, calmly severed Anjalika's banner with a single arrow.
Ashwatthama killed Ghatotkacha's charioteer with two arrows, broke three flagpoles with three arrows, broke his bow with one arrow, and killed four horses with four arrows.
Ashwatthama broke Ghatotkacha's jeweled sword with a sharp arrow.
Ashwatthama shot down Ghatotkacha's golden mace with arrows.
Ghatotkacha leaped into the air and rained down a shower of trees.

Ashwatthama killed the armored Ghatotkacha, son of Bhima.

attributes.relationship: Ashwatthama (son of Drona) kills Ghatotkacha (son of Bhima)

extraction_text: Hidimba (Ghatotkacha's father) witnessed his son's death and confronted Ashwatthama.

attributes.relationship: Ashwatthama tries to avoid fighting Hidimba
